evidence.quote: New technologies like distributed ledgers, tokenized assets, smart contracts, and artificial intelligence (AI) have the potential to make payments smarter, faster, and more efficient.
I see stablecoins, for example, as simply another choice available to consumers and businesses, where they have signaled a need in the market to further improve payments.
Complementary private and public roles can contribute to a safe and efficient payment system.
